contributions.detail: 35 emitted rows sum to 10,015.34 against a printed cover line 1 of 11,566.20 - a delta of -1,550.86, and THE CAUSE IS TRACED ON THE FILER'S OWN ATTACHED LEDGERS (pages 6-8). Page 7 ends 'TOTAL INFLOWS 10,015.34' for his cash account 'Go Mac Contributions & Expenses' - EXACTLY the Form A row sum, which independently confirms the transcription to the cent. Page 8 is a SEPARATE ledger, 'In - Kind Donations', ending 'TOTAL INFLOWS 1,666.28'. Those in-kind contributions were NEVER ITEMISED on Form A but WERE folded into the cover: 10,015.34 + 1,666.28 - 115.42 (cover line 2 CUMULATIVE, the never-itemised $50-or-less aggregate) = 11,566.20 = cover line 1, exactly. So the Form A schedule is a complete and correct transcription of what the filer wrote on it; the printed cover line is on a WIDER basis (cash + in-kind, net of the small-donor aggregate) than the schedule it points at. Published verbatim with needs_review on every row of the side. Cover LAST column is blank on all four lines, so THIS == CUMULATIVE (first report of the cycle) - scope cumulative.
contributions.cover_self_inconsistency: Cover line 2 disagrees with ITSELF: THIS REPORT reads 115.85 and CUMULATIVE REPORT reads 115.42, with the LAST REPORT cell blank, so the identity LAST + THIS = CUMULATIVE cannot hold. Both figures are recorded verbatim above and neither was silently preferred. Only the CUMULATIVE figure (115.42) is consistent with the rest of the cover (11,566.20 + 115.42 = 11,681.62 = line 3, and the balance closes at 0); that is stated as evidence, not as a correction.

expenditures.detail: 45 rows across TWO sheets - the printed Form B (page 3, 36 rows) and the filer's hand-ruled continuation headed 'ITEMIZED EXPENDITURE REPORT - CONT' (page 4, 9 rows) - sum to exactly 11,681.62 = cover line 3 THIS and CUMULATIVE. Page 3 alone sums to 8,519.80 and page 4 to 3,161.82; neither is a printed subtotal (the form prints none), they are stated here only to show where the rows sit. Cross-check on the filer's own attachments: cash OUTFLOWS 10,015.34 (p7) + in-kind OUTFLOWS 1,666.28 (p8) = 11,681.62, the same figure.

gates.page_subtotal: Carr 5-5-PG prints NO page subtotal or schedule total, and the hand-ruled continuation sheet prints none either; gates run against the cover. p2 rows 10,015.34 vs cover line 1 11,566.20 - WOULD NOT GATE, delta -1,550.86 with the cause traced (un-itemised in-kind contributions, see recon.contributions). p3+p4 rows 11,681.62 = cover line 3 11,681.62 - exact.

gates.balance_chain: Cover line 4 reads a plain numeral 0 in both the THIS and CUMULATIVE cells. Chain on the filer's own cover figures: 0 (LAST blank) + 11,566.20 + 115.42 - 11,681.62 = 0.00 - CLOSES EXACTLY, but only on the CUMULATIVE reading of line 2; on the THIS reading (115.85) it would be +0.43 short. Both readings are recorded. The attachments corroborate: each of the two ledgers ends 'NET TOTAL 0.00'. No earlier filing by this filer in this chunk, so no cross-filing cumulative chain check was possible.

escalation_note: Full 600 dpi re-render of the amount column on all three schedule pages in seven slices (every one of the 36 + 36 + 9 values re-read identically); 600 dpi + -normalize on the cover anchor block, which is what settled the line-2 self-inconsistency (115.85 THIS vs 115.42 CUMULATIVE); nine 600 dpi geometry-proof crops.
notes: index.csv says candidate 'McAllister', office 'Treasurer'; the cover reads 'Full Name of Candidate: Craig McAllister', 'Name of Office: TREASURER', 'Office District: CACHE' - AGREES, county office, in scope. Political Party Republican; dated 10/28/14 and clerk-stamped RCVD 28 OCT 2014. EIGHT-PAGE FILING, and the extra pages matter: page 4 is a HAND-RULED CONTINUATION of Form B in the filer's own hand (9 more expenditures) and is transcribed as part of the expenditure side; pages 6-8 are the filer's own printed ledger exports ('Go Mac Contributions & Expenses - All Dates' pages 1-2, and 'In - Kind Donations - All Dates'), which are LANDSCAPE and render rotated in the portrait frame - they are attachments, not schedules, so no rows were transcribed from them, but they are what traces the Form A delta and they corroborate the Form B total exactly. FORM A CARRIES ONE STRUCK-OUT ROW, dropped per the contract: '5/23/14 Byron McAllister (Signs) ... 239.85', ruled through with a single horizontal line. The arithmetic proves the strike is correct twice over - the remaining 35 rows equal the filer's cash-ledger TOTAL INFLOWS exactly (10,015.34), and that same 239.85 reappears on page 4 line 8 (USU Printing, 3 vinyl signs) and inside the in-kind ledger's 'Byron McAllister' total of 664.85 (= 239.85 + 200.00 + 225.00). IN-KIND FLAG NOT SET ANYWHERE, deliberately: this form has no in-kind column and prints no legend, so the rule 'never infer in-kind from a column the form does not have' governs. What the filer DID do is annotate roughly a dozen Form B rows with a third party's name (and often a street address) above the payee and put a small ink dot in the right margin; those annotations line up with his separate In-Kind ledger, and each such row's note records the mark. A HUMAN SHOULD DECIDE whether that dot-plus-annotation convention is enough to set in_kind on those rows. Street addresses, ZIPs, PO boxes, the candidate's home address and both phone numbers are printed in the clear on this filing and were discarded at read time.
